functional.description: The solution uses the Zammad API endpoint 'http://localhost:8080' (or 'http://zammad:8080')
functional.rationale: Ensures the solution connects to the correct Zammad instance

functional.description: The solution uses the Plane API endpoint 'http://localhost:8091' (or 'http://plane-api:8000')
functional.rationale: Ensures the solution connects to the correct Plane instance

functional.description: The solution transfers issue data (title/description) from Plane to the newly created Zammad ticket
functional.rationale: Data integration is the core purpose of this task; verifying the transfer ensures functional completeness.

robustness.description: The solution validates that the Plane issue exists before attempting to create a Zammad ticket
robustness.rationale: Prevents creating tickets with incomplete or incorrect data by confirming the source issue is available

robustness.description: The solution verifies that the Zammad customer exists before attempting to create a ticket
robustness.rationale: Prevents ticket creation failures by confirming the customer is valid in the Zammad system

robustness.description: The solution verifies that the Zammad group exists before attempting to create a ticket
robustness.rationale: Prevents ticket creation failures by confirming the group is valid in the Zammad system

robustness.description: The solution retrieves API credentials from environment variables/config rather than hardcoding them
robustness.rationale: Ensures proper configuration management and prevents hardcoded credentials, maintaining security and portability
